title: ribes alpinum subsp. lucidum

It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Currant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-aging activities. Additionally, Alpine Currant has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
